sources.title: Synthetic null trial of Treatment A on the biomarker
sources.abstract: In this fictional randomized trial of 90 adults, Treatment A showed no biomarker difference versus usual care at 6 weeks. The confidence interval was wide and the follow-up shorter than in the other trial.

sources.title: Synthetic randomized trial of Treatment A
sources.abstract: In this fictional randomized study of 240 adults, Treatment A reduced the fictional biomarker by 8 units versus 3 units with usual care at 12 weeks. Attrition was 18%, and the study was not powered for clinical outcomes.

sources.title: Synthetic observational study of Treatment A
sources.abstract: In this fictional cohort of 1,100 adults, Treatment A was associated with a 4-unit larger biomarker reduction after adjustment. Residual confounding and incomplete outcome capture were possible.
